news.title: StateBench 评估长文档中的状态追踪
news.body: 基准区分查找最近一次更新与追踪多步状态变化，测试模型能否持续跟踪实体和对象。结果取决于基准任务设置。
news.title_original: StateBench: Testing how language models track state changes over long documents

news.title: IBM 用小模型生成符合模板的演示文稿
news.body: Palette 用按设计规范生成的合成数据训练开放权重模型，并以自动检查发现文字溢出和元素重叠等问题。效果取决于模板和训练数据。
news.title_original: Palette: teaching a small model to build decks in your design language

news.title: MIT.nano 会议讨论如何连接共享科研设施
news.body: 报道回顾 10 月 NEMO 用户会议。与会者讨论仪器预约、访问权限和培训，以及如何跨机构找到所需设备。
news.title_original: Building connections across the research infrastructure
news.body_original: MIT.nano and the Northeast Microelectronics Coalition gathered facility leaders and technology professionals from across the nation to explore ways to make shared-access facilities more connected.

news.title: OpenAI 探索将 AI 用于实体产品工程设计
news.body: 文章展示模型协助设计设备外壳、电路板和软件，并讨论制图、仿真与跨专业协作。案例仍处于探索阶段，实际制造需逐项验证。
news.title_original: Accelerating engineering for the physical world
news.body_original: Discover how ChatGPT and Codex are helping engineers accelerate CAD, PCB design, simulation, and other workflows across the physical world.

news.title: 思科结合网络遥测与 AI 辅助安全防御
news.body: 案例介绍思科如何利用网络数据和模型辅助调查与修复。实际成效取决于数据覆盖、部署环境和安全团队审核。
news.title_original: How Cisco defends at machine speed with OpenAI
news.body_original: Cisco combines network intelligence with OpenAI models to strengthen enterprise security. Learn how it is building more adaptive defenses.

news.title: Heimstaden 分享 AI 在住宅租赁与管理中的应用
news.body: 案例介绍借助 ChatGPT 和 Codex 改进房源展示、资产分析与物业运营。文中的成本及采用率来自企业自报，不能外推为所有房地产公司的效果。
news.title_original: Heimstaden is changing residential real estate management with AI
news.body_original: Discover how Heimstaden uses OpenAI’s ChatGPT Enterprise and Codex to transform property management, cut costs, and empower employees across Europe.

news.title: OpenAI 任命 Jill Hazelbaker 为首席企业事务官
news.body: 公司公布任命。Hazelbaker 此前在 Uber 负责全球传播、公共政策等事务，也曾在 Snap 和 Google 任职。
news.title_original: OpenAI appoints Jill Hazelbaker as Chief Corporate Affairs Officer
news.body_original: Jill Hazelbaker will join OpenAI as Chief Corporate Affairs Officer, leading the company’s global communications and corporate positioning.

news.title: CWE-bench v2 公开 100 项漏洞修复任务
news.body: 评估要求智能体在真实开源仓库中找出并修复弱点，同时保留原有功能。公开任务采用程序化评分，并设有独立保留集。
news.title_original: CWE-bench v2: More coverage, quality, and transparency

news.title: Transformers 用小型模型夹具提前发现集成回归
news.body: 文章介绍从真实模型配置构建保留各类层的小型夹具，在 CPU 上运行快速集成测试，并回放定位 UMT5 未来词元泄漏问题。此类检查补充真实检查点和硬件测试，不能覆盖全部训练与部署风险。

news.title: OpenAI 筹备与外部研究人员合作的安全强化行动
news.body: 计划与 Cathedral 等安全伙伴使用模型测试内部系统、复现弱点并验证修复。公告描述下一轮计划及既往实践，不能理解为已消除所有平台漏洞。
news.title_original: Preparing our next security sprint to harden OpenAI
news.body_original: OpenAI is preparing its next internal security sprint with Cathedral Systems to test and strengthen its defenses using AI.

news.title: OpenAI 提高安全漏洞赏金并增设报告奖励
news.body: 更新提高中高危及严重漏洞奖励，并引入报告质量、持续参与和专项活动等加成。具体奖励取决于漏洞目标、严重程度和项目规则，不是每份报告都能获得最高金额。
news.title_original: Rewarding defenders with bigger bug bounties
news.body_original: OpenAI is raising Security Bug Bounty rewards and introducing report quality, loyalty, and priority campaign bonuses for independent security researchers.

news.title: OpenAI 介绍面向智能体并行开发的 Git 扩展
news.body: 工程文章讨论单体仓库并发需求增长，介绍 Pando 架构、推送与读取扩展，以及对 Git 生态的投入。其设计针对特定内部负载，不能直接视为所有团队的通用迁移结论。
news.body_original: How OpenAI built Pando, a Git-compatible backend designed for the scale of development that Codex makes possible.

news.title: OpenAI 推出未来计算园区电网灵活性计划
news.body: Grid Protectors 计划与电力公司和监管方协商，在电网承压时降低园区需求，并按本地条件利用发电或储能。各地承诺仍在落实，不能把目标写成已经实现的电价或可靠性收益。
news.body_original: OpenAI’s Grid Protectors Program will work with utilities to help future compute campuses support grid reliability and protect consumer electricity costs.

news.title: MIT 能源会议讨论转型中的 AI、材料与社会信任
news.body: 报道回顾 9 月研究会议，涵盖废碳利用、AI 与数据中心的公共信任及量子工具等议题。专家讨论与研究方向不等同于技术已经规模化落地。
news.title_original: Powering up for a pivotal moment
news.body_original: From a nuclear revival to qubits, the MIT Energy Initiative’s annual research conference tracked deployment of today’s technologies to discovery of tomorrow’s breakthroughs.

news.title: LifeVal 用日常生活任务评估 AI 助手进展
news.body: 评估从时间使用调查及用户需求出发，关注育儿、公共服务、预算等实际任务。基准表现用于追踪特定任务进步，不能证明所有现实场景都能安全可靠地自动完成。
news.body_original: Introducing LifeVal, a benchmark measuring how well AI helps people complete everyday tasks, from finding childcare to managing finances and government paperwork.

papers.title: 用傅里叶神经算子学习原子间长程相互作用
papers.body: arXiv:2611.03678v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Long-range interactions in machine-learning interatomic potentials are commonly treated by coupling learned sources through either a prescribed electrostatic kernel or a learned but configuration-independent one. Whether such a kernel suffices depends on the underlying screened interaction. We address this question by using Fourier neural operators (FNOs) to learn how latent source fields, built from the descriptors of a local backbone (here MACE), interact across the simulation cell. For a synthetic ionic system with tunable screening, a prescribed Coulomb kernel underestimates the long-wavelength charge fluctuations by 43% under strong screen
papers.summary: 预印本摘要。研究将 MACE 局域特征转化为潜在源场，再用傅里叶神经算子描述跨模拟晶胞的作用。在可调屏蔽的合成离子体系中，模型更好地再现了长波电荷涨落，效果仍需在更多真实材料中验证。

papers.title: 多孔氧化物储能材料的生成式 AI 研究路线
papers.body: arXiv:2608.02858v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The discovery of next-generation energy-storage materials is increasingly limited by the complexity of the underlying design problem rather than by computational capability alone. Porous transition-metal oxides represent a particularly challenging class of battery materials because their performance emerges from coupled interactions among crystal chemistry, pore architecture, ion transport, electrochemistry, electro-chemo-mechanics, synthesis, manufacturing, and battery-system operation. Recent advances in generative artificial intelligence (AI) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities for generating chemically plausible crystal structures
papers.summary: 预印本摘要。观点文章提出将晶体化学、孔隙结构、离子输运及制造约束纳入材料生成与验证。文章梳理研究机会与挑战，所提路线仍有待系统检验。
